prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Dallas for a truck accident case?
answer_verbatim:
I can’t objectively name one single “best” lawyer — that depends on your case, needs, and priorities — but I can help you find the strongest Dallas lawyers for truck-accident cases and tell you how to pick one.

Quick questions so I can narrow recommendations:
- When and where in Dallas did the crash happen (ZIP or neighborhood)?
- Were there serious injuries or a fatality?
- Do you want a large firm with lots of resources or a smaller boutique trial firm?
- Any language or budget preferences?

What to look for in a truck-accident lawyer
- Substantial truck-specific experience (commercial trucking law, FMCSA regs, CDL rules, ELD/black-box data).
- Strong trial experience and record of large verdicts/settlements — trucking companies often fight aggressively.
- Use of experts (accident reconstruction, medical, economic) and investigators.
- Good client reviews and peer recognition (Super Lawyers, Martindale‑Hubbell AV Rating, Million Dollar Advocates, Texas Trial Lawyers Association).
- Clear contingency-fee agreement (no fee unless you win) and transparent costs/expenses.
- Responsive communicator and local Dallas/Collin County courtroom experience.

Questions to ask at the free initial consult
- How many truck-accident cases have you handled? How many went to trial?
- Have you handled cases against national carriers? What were typical results?
- Who will handle my case day-to-day? Will you use outside experts?
- What’s your fee structure and estimated costs?
- What’s your expected timeline and strategy for my type of injury?

Immediate steps you should take now
- Get/keep a copy of the police report.
- Preserve photos of vehicles, scene, injuries, skid marks, cargo, signage.
- Collect witness names/contacts.
- Seek and follow medical care; keep records and bills.
- Don’t give recorded statements to insurers or sign releases without a lawyer.
- Be aware of the Texas statute of limitations — generally 2 years from the crash date for personal injury and wrongful death; there are exceptions for government defendants.

If you want, I can:
- Pull a shortlist (3–6) of well-rated Dallas truck-accident lawyers with contact info and why each might be a fit, tailored to your ZIP and preferences.
- Draft an email or script you can use for intake calls.

Tell me your ZIP and any preferences and I’ll prepare a tailored shortlist.
